notes.title: Signs of Birth Launched
notes.notes:
”Signs of Birth" is now on sale.
This game has undergone two major gameplay changes in the two years since its release. At first, it was developed as a platformer game and then as a mountain climbing game. As third development, with placing importance on feedback from players, the development team has continued to develop the game as a shooting game, 

We have also adjusted the balance of the game and added new features to achieve even deeper gameplay. In addition, we believe that with the later changes we have been able to further enhance the fun and refinement of the game and provide a more satisfying experience for all players. Our evolution over the past two years has been possible thanks to the enthusiastic support of our players.
We apologize to those who have purchased the game so far, as the gameplay will be completely changed. Also, please accept my apologies for any inconvenience caused by my inexperience.

The entire development team would like to express our gratitude and hope that we can continue to provide you with an even better gaming experience in the future.

Thanks!
